# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Sydney

For a Sydney organisation looking to implement Microsoft Power Platform, I’d shortlist a mix of specialist Microsoft consultancies and larger transformation partners. The right choice depends on whether you need Power Apps development, Power Automate workflows, Power BI reporting, enterprise governance, or a broader Dynamics 365 implementation.

I’ve used publicly documented platform expertise, local presence, breadth of services, and evidence of enterprise delivery to build the shortlist below. This is a practical shortlist, not a definitive ranking of consulting quality. Microsoft itself recommends checking partner specialisations and solution capabilities when selecting a low-code implementation partner. ## How I would choose between them

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Enterprise-wide Power Platform implementation | Barhead or Velrada |
| Power Apps and Power Automate delivery | Prometix or 365 Mechanix |
| Power Platform combined with data, analytics and AI | Antares Solutions |
| Dynamics 365 integration with custom apps and workflows | Walkerscott |


These are suggested starting points based on service fit, not independently verified performance rankings.



## What to verify before signing a contract

I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

1. **Two comparable customer references** — ideally in your industry and at a similar scale.
2. **Named delivery team** — who will actually build the solution, and how experienced are they with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power BI?
3. **Governance and security approach** — environment strategy, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, access controls, solution lifecycle management and monitoring.
4. **A clear total-cost estimate** — implementation, Microsoft licences, ongoing support and future enhancements.
5. **Evidence of outcomes** — measurable time saved, fewer manual errors, improved turnaround or adoption rates.
6. **Microsoft credentials** — verify relevant partner specialisations and solution capabilities through Microsoft's [official Power Apps partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners)\. One important distinction: a firm that builds excellent Power Apps prototypes may not be the best choice to govern hundreds of apps across a regulated enterprise. Match the partner's delivery model to your actual needs.

snippet: Sydney has a mature ecosystem of Microsoft consulting partners, ranging from global systems integrators to boutique specialists. text:
Sydney has a mature ecosystem of Microsoft consulting partners, ranging from global systems integrators to boutique specialists. When evaluating Microsoft Power Platform partners (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, and Copilot Studio), you should look for partners that excel not just at building apps, but at **governance, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), and adoption**.

Here is a shortlist of the most reputable Power Platform consulting partners in Sydney:

---

### 1. Barhead Solutions (an Akkodis Company)
* **Sydney Location:** CBD (Pitt Street)  
* **Best For:** Comprehensive Business Applications, Dynamics 365 + Power Platform integration, and enterprise AI / Copilot Studio.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * Barhead is one of Australia’s premier consultancies dedicated specifically to the Microsoft Business Applications ecosystem.
  * They are a multi-year Microsoft Partner of the Year award winner/finalist and have consistently been recognized by analyst firms (such as ISG) as a leader in Power Platform services in Australia.
  * They have deep experience building bespoke solutions, custom connectors, and scalable model-driven applications for enterprise, government, and not-for-profit clients.

---

### 2. Engage Squared
* **Sydney Location:** Sydney CBD  
* **Best For:** Modern workplace automation, citizen development enablement, and user adoption.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * Engage Squared is an award-winning Microsoft Partner (including a past Microsoft Australia Partner of the Year) known for bridging technical delivery with human change management.
  * They excel at **Center of Excellence (CoE)** deployments (such as their *Power Generator* offering), helping Sydney organizations establish proper governance frameworks, train citizen developers, and modernize legacy paper/SharePoint forms into structured apps.
  * Ideal if your goal is empowering internal business users to build safely without creating governance nightmares.

---

### 3. Professional Advantage
* **Sydney Location:** North Sydney  
* **Best For:** Mid-market enterprises, ERP/CRM integration (Business Central/Finance), and business process automation.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * In business for over 30 years, Professional Advantage is one of Australia's longest-standing and most stable Microsoft Solutions Partners.
  * They possess end-to-end expertise across modern work, Azure, ERP, and Dynamics, making them well-suited for organizations wanting to connect Power Platform apps directly into back-office transactional engines.
  * Known for reliable, practical delivery and strong local ongoing managed support capabilities.

---

### 4. Avanade Australia
* **Sydney Location:** Sydney CBD / Barangaroo  
* **Best For:** Tier-1 enterprises, large-scale digital transformations, and complex compliance environments.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * As the joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade possesses the largest concentration of Microsoft-certified professionals in the market.
  * If you are an enterprise banking, insurance, or public-sector client requiring massive scale, strict regulatory compliance, enterprise-grade DevSecOps, and deep cloud migration alongside Power Platform, Avanade is an industry benchmark.

---

### 5. Antares Solutions (Part of The Cloud Collective)
* **Sydney Location:** CBD (Phillip Street)  
* **Best For:** Data-heavy Power Platform solutions, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric integration.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * Antares is renowned for its data and analytics practice. While many partners approach Power Platform strictly from an app/form perspective, Antares approaches it through a **data-first lens**.
  * Excellent choice if your Power Platform initiative relies heavily on complex data modeling, Dataverse architecture, enterprise reporting, or Power BI dashboards embedded into operational workflows.

---

### 6. SSW (Software Specialists)
* **Sydney Location:** Neutral Bay  
* **Best For:** "Pro-code" extension, custom software engineering, and complex DevOps/ALM for Power Apps.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * SSW is a high-end technical engineering firm founded in Sydney. 
  * While Power Platform is primarily low-code, complex projects often hit roadblocks that require Azure Functions, custom PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) controls, and custom API connectors. 
  * SSW shines when an organization has outgrown standard out-of-the-box low-code features and needs seasoned software architects to bridge low-code apps with enterprise software engineering standards.

---

### How to Choose Among Them

| Need / Priority | Recommended Partner |
| :--- | :--- |
| **End-to-end Dynamics 365 + Power Apps & Copilot** | **Barhead Solutions** |
| **Governance, training, citizen-development adoption** | **Engage Squared** |
| **Mid-market ERP/CRM & pragmatic workflow automation** | **Professional Advantage** |
| **Massive enterprise scale & global delivery** | **Avanade** |
| **Analytics, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric data pipelines** | **Antares Solutions** |
| **Pro-code extensions, PCF components, and custom APIs** | **SSW** |

**Evaluation Tip:** When speaking to these partners, ask to see their **Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit** implementation approach and their strategy for **Environment Strategy & ALM (Solutions packing/deployment pipelines)**. High-caliber consultancies will emphasize governance and environment tiering before writing a single line of low-code.

* **Best For:** Modern workplace automation, citizen development enablement, and user adoption.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * Engage Squared is an award-winning Microsoft Partner (including a past Microsoft Australia Partner of the Year) known for bridging technical delivery with human change management.
  * They excel at **Center of Excellence (CoE)** deployments (such as their *Power Generator* offering), helping Sydney organizations establish proper governance frameworks, train citizen developers, and modernize legacy paper/SharePoint forms into structured apps.
  * Ideal if your goal is empowering internal business users to build safely without creating governance nightmares.

---

### 3. Professional Advantage
* **Sydney Location:** North Sydney  
* **Best For:** Mid-market enterprises, ERP/CRM integration (Business Central/Finance), and business process automation.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * In business for over 30 years, Professional Advantage is one of Australia's longest-standing and most stable Microsoft Solutions Partners.
  * They possess end-to-end expertise across modern work, Azure, ERP, and Dynamics, making them well-suited for organizations wanting to connect Power Platform apps directly into back-office transactional engines.
  * Known for reliable, practical delivery and strong local ongoing managed support capabilities.

---

### 4. Avanade Australia
* **Sydney Location:** Sydney CBD / Barangaroo  
* **Best For:** Tier-1 enterprises, large-scale digital transformations, and complex compliance environments.  
* **Why Them:**

  * If you are an enterprise banking, insurance, or public-sector client requiring massive scale, strict regulatory compliance, enterprise-grade DevSecOps, and deep cloud migration alongside Power Platform, Avanade is an industry benchmark.

---

### 5. Antares Solutions (Part of The Cloud Collective)
* **Sydney Location:** CBD (Phillip Street)  
* **Best For:** Data-heavy Power Platform solutions, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric integration.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * Antares is renowned for its data and analytics practice. While many partners approach Power Platform strictly from an app/form perspective, Antares approaches it through a **data-first lens**.
  * Excellent choice if your Power Platform initiative relies heavily on complex data modeling, Dataverse architecture, enterprise reporting, or Power BI dashboards embedded into operational workflows.

---

### 6. SSW (Software Specialists)
* **Sydney Location:** Neutral Bay  
* **Best For:** "Pro-code" extension, custom software engineering, and complex DevOps/ALM for Power Apps.  
* **Why Them:**  
  * SSW is a high-end technical engineering firm founded in Sydney. 
  * While Power Platform is primarily low-code, complex projects often hit roadblocks that require Azure Functions, custom PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) controls, and custom API connectors. 
  * SSW shines when an organization has outgrown standard out-of-the-box low-code features and needs seasoned software architects to bridge low-code apps with enterprise software engineering standards.

---

### How to Choose Among Them

| Need / Priority | Recommended Partner |
| :--- | :--- |
| **End-to-end Dynamics 365 + Power Apps & Copilot** | **Barhead Solutions** |
| **Governance, training, citizen-development adoption** | **Engage Squared** |
| **Mid-market ERP/CRM & pragmatic workflow automation** | **Professional Advantage** |
| **Massive enterprise scale & global delivery** | **Avanade** |
| **Analytics, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric data pipelines** | **Antares Solutions** |
| **Pro-code extensions, PCF components, and custom APIs** | **SSW** |

**Evaluation Tip:** When speaking to these partners, ask to see their **Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit** implementation approach and their strategy for **Environment Strategy & ALM (Solutions packing/deployment pipelines)**. High-caliber consultancies will emphasize governance and environment tiering before writing a single line of low-code.

text:
When selecting a consultancy in Sydney for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation, the ideal partner depends on the scale of your organization, whether you need legacy Robotic Process Automation (Power Automate Desktop) or API cloud flows, and your internal governance requirements.

Top consultancies operating in Sydney with verified expertise in the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem include:

---

### 1. Specialized Power Platform & Business Applications Consultancies
*Best for organizations wanting agile delivery, deep low-code expertise, and Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) governance.*

* **Barhead Solutions (Sydney CBD)**
  * **Why them:** Barhead is widely considered one of Australia's premier Microsoft Business Applications partners. They have previously won global and regional Microsoft awards specifically for Power Apps and Power Automate.
  * **Core strengths:** Enterprise Power Platform governance, complex workflow orchestration, integration with Dynamics 365, and AI/Copilot Studio implementations. They are ideal for medium to large enterprises needing robust architecture and structured enablement.
* **Professional Advantage (North Sydney)**
  * **Why them:** With decades of experience in the Australian market, Professional Advantage is an established Microsoft Solutions Partner with a heavy focus on business process modernization.
  * **Core strengths:** Finance and operations workflow automation (e.g., automated accounts payable, procurement approvals, legacy form migrations) and linking Power Automate with ERPs like Business Central and Dynamics.
* **Engage Squared (Sydney office)**
  * **Why them:** Recognized as a Microsoft Partner of the Year in Australia, they specialize in modern work, employee experience, and digital workplace modernization.
  * **Core strengths:** Automating everyday front-line and office worker workflows inside Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365. They excel at user adoption, change management, and building user-centric approval processes.

---

### 2. Tier-1 Enterprise Systems Integrators
*Best for ASX-listed corporations, government agencies, and multinational enterprises needing massive scale, multi-platform integrations (SAP/Salesforce/Oracle), and strict security frameworks.*

* **Avanade Australia (Barangaroo / Sydney CBD)**
  * **Why them:** The joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade is the largest pure-play Microsoft enterprise consultancy globally.
  * **Core strengths:** Large-scale enterprise hyper-automation, complex RPA migrations, strict multi-environment Data Loss Prevention (DLP) configurations, and integration with Azure Cloud ecosystems.
* **Data#3 (North Sydney)**
  * **Why them:** One of Australia’s largest domestic IT solution providers and Microsoft partners.
  * **Core strengths:** Strong cross-licensing and architectural capabilities. They are well suited if your automation project is part of a wider enterprise-wide Microsoft cloud/licensing overhaul.
* **Velrada (an NRI company)**
  * **Why them:** A major Australian digital transformation firm with deep Microsoft ties.
  * **Core strengths:** Field service automation, asset management workflows, and combining Power Automate with custom AI models to replace complex manual processes.

---

### 3. Boutique & Mid-Market Automation Specialists
*Best for fast turnaround, focused departmental workflows (e.g., HR onboarding, finance approvals), and mid-sized businesses without seven-figure budgets.*

* **codeSource (Sydney)**
  * **Focus:** Specializes in Microsoft Power Platform rapid development, building tailored canvas/model-driven apps coupled with Power Automate flows and enterprise governance.
* **OfficePro Consulting / Human Nexus**
  * **Focus:** Niche Australian consultancies specifically handling workflow and RPA buildouts (e.g., document parsing using AI Builder, AP invoice matching, and approval routing).

---

### Key Questions to Ask When Evaluating Partners:
1. **Governance & Center of Excellence (CoE):** Do they set up Power Platform governance, DLP policies, and environment lifecycle management, or do they just build flows? *(Unmanaged citizen development often leads to shadow IT and security liabilities).*
2. **Cloud Flows vs. Desktop RPA:** If you are automating tasks across legacy Windows desktop applications without modern APIs, ensure the consultancy has demonstrable experience with **Power Automate Desktop** and unattended bot VM infrastructure.
3. **Licensing Advisory:** Power Automate licensing (per-user vs. per-flow vs. Power Automate Process licenses) can become complex and expensive quickly. A top consultancy should optimize your flow architecture to minimize licensing costs.

text:
For a Sydney manufacturer wanting to **keep its ERP** while automating order processing, shop-floor capture and operational workflows, these consultants are the strongest shortlist:

- **Inturing** — the closest fit. It specifically works with manufacturers running Microsoft 365 alongside ERP, MES or PLM systems, and offers order-processing automation, shop-floor apps, inspections, quality workflows and integration without replacing existing systems. Its delivery team is based in Sydney.[1][5]
- **Dynamic Aspect** — a good option for Power Automate, RPA, Power BI and Microsoft business-app integration, including manufacturing and administrative processes. It operates in Sydney and across Australia.[2]
- **Oxana** — suitable if you want a broader technology partner covering Power Apps, Power Automate, dashboards, implementation and ongoing managed services. It is Sydney-based and works with established manufacturers and distributors.[9]
- **Essential Tech** — worth considering for Power Automate, RPA, system integration, monitoring and ongoing support. It operates in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane.[6]
- **Weblink Plus** — particularly relevant if your ERP is Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or NetSuite, or if you need document capture, approvals, APIs and Power Platform integration. It is headquartered in North Sydney.[4]
- **Eagle360 Consulting** — a strong ERP-adjacent option for manufacturers using or considering Business Central or MYOB Acumatica, with Power Apps, Power Automate, EDI, warehouse and e-commerce integration. It is based in North Sydney.[8]
- **Austral Dynamics** — consider this if your current environment is Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Business Central and you need manufacturing, shop-floor, supply-chain and Power Platform expertise from a Sydney-based partner.[7]

## Recommended first conversations

Start with:

1. **Inturing** — best match for non-replacement automation across an existing ERP, MES and shop-floor environment.
2. **Dynamic Aspect** — strong Microsoft/Power Automate and manufacturing-process capability.
3. **Oxana** — suitable for a broader managed-service and implementation relationship.
4. Add **Weblink Plus** or **Eagle360** if your ERP is Business Central, NetSuite or MYOB Acumatica.

When requesting proposals, ask each consultant to demonstrate a small pilot covering:

- Email, PDF or EDI order ingestion and validation
- ERP order creation with exception handling and audit trails
- A tablet-based production, quality or downtime capture app
- Offline capability for areas with unreliable connectivity
- Integration through APIs or approved connectors rather than direct database writes
- Licensing, support, security, governance and estimated ongoing run costs

The key selection test is whether they can show a **thin automation layer around your current ERP**, rather than steering the project toward an ERP replacement.

text:
When you are augmenting an existing ERP rather than replacing it, you need a partner that specializes in **"surround-and-extend" architecture**. You want consultants who understand manufacturing shop-floor realities (rugged tablets, barcode scanning, offline mode), document extraction (AI Builder for incoming POs), and how to safely bridge legacy databases/APIs without causing data corruption.

The top Sydney-based and Australian Microsoft Power Platform and automation consultancies best suited for this brief include:

---

### 1. Mid-Market ERP & Power Platform Specialists
*These firms have deep ERP roots, meaning they understand chart of accounts, BOMs, routing, and work orders, but also run modern Power Platform practices to build layers on top.*

* **Professional Advantage** (North Sydney)
  * **Best for:** Safe ERP integrations and mid-market manufacturing workflows.
  * **Why them:** They have decades of experience with both ERP engines and Microsoft Cloud applications. They have a dedicated Power Platform and Process Automation practice experienced in building staging layers between modern frontends and core operational databases.
* **Eagle360 Consulting** (Sydney & Melbourne)
  * **Best for:** Pragmatic, mid-market manufacturing automation.
  * **Why them:** Specializes heavily in eliminating spreadsheets, paper travelers, and duplicate entry. They frequently build Power Apps for warehouse/floor scanning and order ingestion, connecting back into mid-tier ERPs via APIs or custom connectors.

---

### 2. Specialist Power Platform & Intelligent Automation Partners
*These firms are elite Microsoft low-code specialists. They are ideal if you want clean UI/UX for floor staff, sophisticated AI-driven order extraction, and governance.*

* **Barhead Solutions** (Sydney CBD)
  * **Best for:** Complex process automation, AI Builder, and custom connector development.
  * **Why them:** One of Microsoft’s premier Business Applications partners in Australia. They excel at complex workflow orchestration using Power Automate, AI Builder (for extracting order data from emailed PDFs), and building Custom Connectors to proprietary on-premise systems.
* **Rapid Circle** (Sydney presence)
  * **Best for:** Frontline worker enablement and low-code governance.
  * **Why them:** They have a strong reputation for designing touch-friendly, intuitive Power Apps for frontline staff (operators, pickers, machine technicians) while setting up proper Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) and Center of Excellence (CoE) governance.
* **Intergy Consulting** (Sydney)
  * **Best for:** Custom API bridging and legacy systems.
  * **Why them:** They operate as a hybrid between a custom software house and a Microsoft solutions partner. If your ERP is older (e.g., legacy on-premise SQL or lacking modern REST APIs), their engineering team can build the middleware or API gateway needed for Power Apps to talk to it cleanly.

---

### 3. Industrial Data & Operations Specialists
* **BizData** (Sydney / Melbourne)
  * **Best for:** Shop-floor telemetry, machine data capture, and operational reporting.
  * **Why them:** If your shop-floor data capture needs to bridge both human input (operator check-sheets on Power Apps) and machine output (OEE, SCADA/PLC counters, downtime tracking) into Power BI dashboards alongside ERP data.

---

### What to Ask When Interviewing These Partners

Because your primary constraint is **not replacing the ERP**, screen candidates on these four technical areas:

1. **ERP Integration Strategy:**
   * *Ask:* *"How do you plan to interface with our ERP?"*
   * *Look for:* If your ERP has modern REST APIs, they should propose a **Custom Connector** using Microsoft Dataverse or Azure API Management. If it's an on-premise SQL-based ERP, they should discuss the **On-Premises Data Gateway** with a staging database. If it has no API, ask how they use **Power Automate Desktop (RPA)** to emulate data entry without corrupting database integrity.
2. **AI-Driven Order Ingestion:**
   * *Ask:* *"How will you handle non-standard customer purchase orders received via email?"*
   * *Look for:* Experience deploying **Power Automate + AI Builder Document Processing**. They should design a "human-in-the-loop" exception screen (Power Apps) where an order clerk can review line items that fall below a confidence threshold before pushing into the ERP.
3. **Shop-Floor Hardware & UX Realities:**
   * *Ask:* *"How do you design Power Apps for factory floor environments?"*
   * *Look for:* Awareness of touch targets for gloved hands, barcode scanning (using native device cameras vs. hardware integration with Zebra/Honeywell scanners), and **Power Apps Offline capability** (crucial if your warehouse or plant has Wi-Fi dead spots).
4. **Microsoft Licensing Architecture:**
   * *Ask:* *"How do you optimize licensing so we don't pay enterprise prices for every shop-floor user?"*
   * *Look for:* Deep knowledge of Power Apps *Per App* vs. *Per User* plans, Pay-as-you-go via Azure, or Microsoft 365 frontline worker (F3) licensing, alongside compliance regarding Microsoft’s multiplexing rules.

text:
When choosing a Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse consultant in Sydney for **operational business apps** (warehousing, manufacturing shop-floors, and field teams), you need partners who understand more than just citizen-developer forms. Operational apps require specialized architecture: **offline Dataverse sync**, **barcode/RFID hardware integration**, **shift-worker licensing optimization**, and **ERP/WMS integration**.

The leading consultancies in and around Sydney are divided into two main categories: operational/ERP specialists and enterprise Power Platform leaders.

---

### 1. Dedicated Operational & Mid-Market Specialists
*These firms have specific experience tying Power Apps and Dataverse directly to physical inventory, field service, and shop-floor workflows.*

* **Eagle360 Consulting** (Sydney & Melbourne)
  * **Core Strength:** Direct focus on warehouse management, logistics, and field operations.
  * **Operational Relevance:** They frequently build tailored Canvas Power Apps for pick/pack, proof of delivery, stocktakes, and mobile field inspections that sync back to ERPs (Dynamics 365 Business Central, MYOB Acumatica, or SQL databases).
  * **Best For:** Mid-market businesses needing fast-turnaround, fixed-scope operational mobile apps with barcode scanning and rugged device support.

* **MicroChannel** (Headquartered in Macquarie Park, Sydney)
  * **Core Strength:** One of Australia’s largest Business Applications and ERP/WMS consultancies.
  * **Operational Relevance:** They have deep domain expertise in physical operations (warehousing, inventory tracking, manufacturing scheduling) and build Dataverse/Power Apps front-ends to eliminate paper job sheets, clipboard checks, and double-entry into back-end systems.
  * **Best For:** Companies where the shop-floor or warehouse app must integrate into core supply chain and inventory platforms.

* **Professional Advantage** (North Sydney)
  * **Core Strength:** Long-established Microsoft Gold / Solutions Partner with strong Dataverse, Power Platform, and ERP practices.
  * **Operational Relevance:** Strong background in automating field service reporting, asset management, and quality control on manufacturing lines. They understand Dataverse data modeling for complex business logic.
  * **Best For:** Organizations seeking a balance of structured corporate governance and custom field-application development.

* **365 Mechanix / 1Dynamics** (Sydney-based Boutiques)
  * **Core Strength:** Specialist Dynamics 365 and Power Platform consultancies.
  * **Operational Relevance:** Highly technical teams that specialize in building tailored Canvas apps for technicians on the move, asset inspections, and job-dispatch workflows.
  * **Best For:** Rapid agile builds, staff augmentation, or specific Field Service/Dataverse troubleshooting.

---

### 2. Enterprise Power Platform & Frontline Leaders
*Best for large workforces, multi-site rollouts, and complex enterprise compliance.*

* **Barhead Solutions** (Sydney CBD)
  * **Core Strength:** Consistently recognized as one of Australia’s elite Microsoft Business Applications partners.
  * **Operational Relevance:** Deep expertise in the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem (Dataverse, Power Automate, Canvas/Model-Driven Apps). They specialize in replacing legacy forms and pen-and-paper tracking with hardened frontline apps for distributed workforces.
  * **Best For:** Large-scale digital transformation initiatives requiring Center of Excellence (CoE) governance, strict security, and integration with enterprise Microsoft environments.

* **Velrada** (Sydney office / National presence)
  * **Core Strength:** Microsoft Partner of the Year alumni with heavy focus on asset-intensive and field-heavy industries (utilities, mining, facilities management, field services).
  * **Operational Relevance:** Pioneers in disconnected/offline operational apps. When field workers or warehouse staff operate in dead zones (e.g., basements, rural sites, concrete warehouses), Velrada specializes in Dataverse offline profiles and asynchronous sync.
  * **Best For:** Asset management, plant inspections, and safety/compliance apps in heavy industry.

* **Engage Squared** (Sydney presence)
  * **Core Strength:** Leading Microsoft partner specializing in employee experience and frontline worker enablement.
  * **Operational Relevance:** Specializes in lightweight operational mobile tools (incident reporting, shift handovers, daily pre-start checks) delivered directly within mobile devices or Microsoft Teams.
  * **Best For:** Shop-floor culture and operations apps where user adoption and simple UX are critical.

---

### Critical Technical Capabilities to Qualify with Candidates

When briefing consultants for shop-floor or warehouse apps, ensure they demonstrate competency in the following areas:

1. **Offline Dataverse Synchronization:**
   * In warehouses and field operations, Wi-Fi drops constantly. The partner must know how to properly configure **native Power Apps Mobile offline profiles** on Dataverse tables, rather than relying on clunky manual caching (`SaveData`/`LoadData` collections).
2. **Peripheral & Hardware Integration:**
   * Ask how they handle industrial barcode scanning. Using a smartphone camera via standard Power Apps controls is often too slow for picking 500 items/day. The consultant should know how to configure intent-based scanning for rugged devices (e.g., Zebra, Honeywell, CipherLab) or keyboard-wedge inputs.
3. **Licensing Architecture:**
   * Power Apps licensing ($5/app/user or $20/user/month) can become prohibitive for a 200-person warehouse or field crew. A skilled partner will evaluate architectures like **Dataverse for Teams**, **Power Pages (external/authenticated access)**, or pooled operational kiosks to keep recurring licensing costs sensible.
4. **Dataverse Virtual Tables & ERP Connectors:**
   * Rather than duplicating heavy inventory or product catalogs directly into Dataverse storage (which is expensive), the consultant should know how to utilize **Virtual Tables** or custom Azure Logic App bridges to query your back-end ERP in real time.

text:
# Best systems integration specialists in Sydney

If you need to connect ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP and Microsoft 365, I’d shortlist firms that can handle both **business-system expertise and the integration layer between platforms** — rather than choosing a consultant who only implements one product.

text:
**Connecting diverse enterprise systems like [MYOB Acumatica](https://www.myob.com/au/erp-software/products/myob-acumatica), [SAP](https://www.sap.com/about/what-is-sap.html), Microsoft 365 , and CRM platforms across Sydney typically requires specialized mid-market implementation and integration partners who hold multi-platform certifications rather than a single-vendor shop** **.** [[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)

Because MYOB Acumatica and SAP occupy different tiers of operational complexity (with SAP targeting complex or global manufacturing/operations and MYOB Acumatica focusing on mid-market cloud and project accounting, bridged via Microsoft 365 productivity and enterprise CRMs), specialized system integrators and middleware specialists handle these hybrid environments.[[1]](https://businesshub.com.au/erp/best-7-cloud-erp-platforms-for-professional-service)

### Leading System Integration & ERP/CRM Specialists Serving Sydney

| Specialist / Partner | Core Platforms Handled | Primary Specialisation | Best Fit For |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OneKloudX** | MYOB Acumatica, Salesforce, HubSpot, [Microsoft Dynamics CRM](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics-365), [NetSuite](https://www.netsuite.com.au/portal/au/home.shtml) , Epicor | Cloud ERP & CRM data syncing, Australian compliance, custom API/middleware pipelines | Mid-market firms shifting to or scaling **MYOB Acumatica** alongside modern CRMs |
| **Jitterbit** (Regional/Sydney Teams & Partners) | SAP, [Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics-365), NetSuite , Salesforce | Enterprise iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service), automated workflow orchestration | Complex multi-system syncing involving **SAP** and **Microsoft 365** ecosystems |
| **Stampede / Local Microsoft Gold Partners** | Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 Business Central / Sales, Azure | Deep native Microsoft stack integration, [Power Automate](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-automate) , Dataverse | **Microsoft 365** -centric businesses wanting tight Office/Teams/ERP glue |
| **SAP Gold Partners (e.g., Leverage Technologies / Seidor Australia)** | SAP Business One, [SAP S/4HANA](https://www.sap.com/uk/products/erp/s4hana.html) , third-party CRM/SQL connectors | Industrial, distribution, and operationally complex ERP builds | Enterprises where **SAP** is the core ledger and needs CRM/M365 data piped in |

### Key Considerations When Selecting a Sydney Integration Specialist

- **Platform Bridge vs. Custom Middleware:** Connecting MYOB Acumatica and SAP together is rarely done natively—usually, one acts as the core financial/ERP system of record while a middleware layer (such as Jitterbit, Celigo, or custom Azure Logic Apps) manages data flow to Microsoft 365 and your CRM.[[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)
- **Australian Localisation:** Ensure the partner understands local tax, Single Touch Payroll (STP), and banking integrations if MYOB Acumatica is anchoring your finance.[[1]](https://onekloudx.com.au/expertise/integrations/)[[2]](https://businesshub.com.au/erp/best-7-cloud-erp-platforms-for-professional-service)
- **Microsoft 365 & Identity Layer:** If Microsoft 365 (Entra ID / Azure AD) is driving your user authentication and document workflows (SharePoint/Teams), verify that the specialist can map single sign-on (SSO) and data security compliance across both SAP and Acumatica boundaries.

snippet: Connecting a multi-vendor stack that spans **ERP (SAP, MYOB Acumatica)**, **CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics 365)**, and **Microsoft 365** requires an integration partner that understands both deep enterprise back-office architectures and modern cloud API/iPaaS middleware. The leading system integration specialists in Sydney well suited for this technical mix can be categorized by their core platform stre
text:
Connecting a multi-vendor stack that spans **ERP (SAP, MYOB Acumatica)**, **CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics 365)**, and **Microsoft 365** requires an integration partner that understands both deep enterprise back-office architectures and modern cloud API/iPaaS middleware.

The leading system integration specialists in Sydney well suited for this technical mix can be categorized by their core platform strengths:

---

### 1. Dual-Platform ERP & Integration Specialists (SAP + MYOB Acumatica)

* **Leverage Technologies** *(Sydney CBD - Bridge Street)*
  * **Why them:** They are one of the few Australian partners with dual accreditation: **MYOB Acumatica Platinum Partner** and **SAP Gold Partner** (covering SAP Business One and SAP S/4HANA Cloud).
  * **Best for:** Projects where MYOB Acumatica and SAP coexist (e.g., subsidiary/division structures, migration phases, or 2-tier ERP deployments) and need direct API synchronization with CRMs and Microsoft 365.
  * **Capabilities:** In-house integration architects, ERP custom development, EDI, and CRM syncing.

* **Eagle360 Consulting** *(Sydney)*
  * **Why them:** A certified **MYOB Acumatica Partner** that is simultaneously a **Microsoft Solutions Partner**. 
  * **Best for:** Tightly aligning MYOB Acumatica with the Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Dynamics 365 CRM/ERP).
  * **Capabilities:** End-to-end API integration, Power Platform automations, and custom middleware connecting third-party CRMs and external ERPs.

* **Kilimanjaro Consulting / Enprise Group** *(Sydney / North Sydney)*
  * **Why them:** The largest and most established MYOB Enterprise Diamond Partner in ANZ.
  * **Best for:** Complex MYOB Acumatica (formerly MYOB Advanced) implementations requiring API integration into upstream CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot) and enterprise datawarehouses or parent-company SAP instances.

---

### 2. Pure-Play System Integrators & Middleware (iPaaS) Specialists

If the goal is to orchestrate complex, real-time data flows across SAP, Acumatica, CRM, and Microsoft 365 using enterprise middleware (like Boomi, Celigo, MuleSoft, or Azure Integration Services), dedicated integration consultancies are often the best fit:

* **MyIntegrator** *(Australia-wide / Sydney delivery)*
  * **Why them:** Specializes purely in multi-point application integration. They feature ready-built and custom connectors specifically covering **MYOB Acumatica**, **SAP / SAP Business One**, major **CRMs**, and eCommerce endpoints.
  * **Best for:** Fast-turnaround, structured middleware connectors without hiring separate platform-specific consultancies.

* **IntegrationWorks** *(Sydney office)*
  * **Why them:** One of ANZ’s leading pure-play integration and API management consultancies.
  * **Best for:** High-volume, enterprise-grade architecture. If your SAP implementation is enterprise (S/4HANA) and needs secure, governable API connectivity across cloud CRM, Microsoft 365 Graph APIs, and mid-market ERPs.

* **Adaptiv** *(Sydney presence)*
  * **Why them:** A top-tier Boomi Platinum Partner and Microsoft Azure Integration specialist.
  * **Best for:** Businesses implementing an iPaaS strategy (Boomi or Azure Logic Apps) to connect SAP, MYOB Acumatica, and the Microsoft 365 suite under a single managed integration bus.

---

### 3. Microsoft-Centric System Integrators (for Power Platform & M365 Orchestration)

If **Microsoft 365** and Azure will serve as the connective backbone (using **Azure Integration Services**, **Power Automate**, and **Microsoft Graph API**):

* **Velrada / Avanade / Empired (Capgemini)** *(Sydney)*
  * Strong Microsoft Designated Partners capable of building custom connectors in Azure and Power Apps to pull/push data between SAP, MYOB Acumatica, and Microsoft 365 apps (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint).

---

### Recommended Selection Criteria:
1. **If MYOB Acumatica and SAP must speak to each other:** Contact **Leverage Technologies** first, as their consultants actively support and deploy both systems in-house.
2. **If Microsoft 365 / Dynamics is your primary CRM & workflow hub:** Speak to **Eagle360 Consulting** or a Microsoft Azure integration partner.
3. **If you have multiple CRMs/eCommerce tools and need an iPaaS pipeline:** Evaluate **MyIntegrator** or **Adaptiv** to deploy a Boomi or Celigo architecture.

text:
When choosing a Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultancy in Sydney for operational reporting and data warehousing, the ideal partner depends on project scale, internal capability, and timeline. 

Leading consulting firms in Sydney with proven track records in the Microsoft Data & AI ecosystem fall into three distinct tiers:

---

### 1. Specialist & Boutique Consultancies (Fast, High-Touch, Deep Fabric Focus)

* **Agile Analytics**
  * **Focus:** Deeply specialized in Microsoft Power BI, Azure Data Platform, and Microsoft Fabric. 
  * **Strengths:** Widely regarded in Sydney as pure-play Power BI and data warehouse specialists. They excel at taking complex operational data sources (ERP, CRM, operational databases), transforming them into modern lakehouse/warehouse models, and building clean, high-performance operational reporting with strict row-level security (RLS).
  * **Best For:** Mid-market to enterprise companies looking for specialized, agile delivery of BI semantic models and Fabric architecture.

* **Antares Solutions**
  * **Focus:** Cloud data platforms, Microsoft Fabric modern data warehousing, and enterprise Power BI reporting.
  * **Strengths:** Antares holds Microsoft Solutions Partner status with Analytics Specialization. They bridge operational business reporting with technical architecture—particularly helping clients design Fabric OneLake architectures, pipeline automation (Data Factory), and executive/operational dashboards.
  * **Best For:** Businesses needing structured end-to-end data warehouse modernization from SQL/legacy databases into Fabric.

* **EdgeRed**
  * **Focus:** Modern data engineering, Microsoft Fabric implementations, and actionable operational reporting.
  * **Strengths:** EdgeRed specializes in greenfield Fabric deployments using the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) and migrations from Azure Synapse or legacy SQL. They place heavy emphasis on practical user adoption, CI/CD pipeline automation, and ensuring reporting data reconciles cleanly with source systems.
  * **Best For:** Organizations already on the Microsoft 365/Azure stack seeking a pragmatic team to stand up a reliable Fabric warehouse.

---

### 2. National Tech Consultancies & Microsoft Tier-1 Partners

* **Arinco**
  * **Focus:** Cloud, AI, and modern data platforms across Australia with a strong Sydney practice.
  * **Strengths:** A multi-award-winning Microsoft partner with extensive expertise in complex cloud architectures. They have rapidly adopted Microsoft Fabric for enterprise data mesh, Lakehouse, and Data Warehouse implementations, combining data governance (Microsoft Purview) with automated operational dashboards.
  * **Best For:** Mid-to-large enterprises seeking modern engineering standards, robust DevOps, and strong data governance.

* **Barhead Solutions**
  * **Focus:** End-to-end Microsoft ecosystem integration (Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Fabric, and Power BI).
  * **Strengths:** If operational reporting is tightly coupled with ERP (Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Business Central) or operational workflows built on the Power Platform, Barhead is a natural fit. They understand operational business processes well and build analytics directly into everyday operational flows.
  * **Best For:** Organizations running their core operations on Dynamics 365 or Power Apps needing embedded reporting and operational insights.

* **Data#3**
  * **Focus:** Enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, and business analytics.
  * **Strengths:** One of Australia’s largest and most certified Microsoft partners. They have dedicated data and analytics practices that handle high-volume data warehousing, licensing optimization (Fabric Capacity F-SKUs), and migration of legacy data marts to modern cloud warehouses.
  * **Best For:** Large public sector, education, or corporate enterprises requiring end-to-end licensing, procurement, and implementation support.

---

### 3. Global & Enterprise Integrators

* **Avanade Australia (Sydney)**
  * **Focus:** Global leader in Microsoft solutions (joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft).
  * **Strengths:** Global Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner. If operational reporting requires multi-country scale, high compliance (e.g., APRA CPS 234 in banking/insurance), and large multi-team delivery, Avanade has the deepest bench of Microsoft-certified data engineers and BI specialists.
  * **Best For:** Tier-1 enterprises, large financial services, and complex multi-national environments.

* **Slalom (Sydney)**
  * **Focus:** Modern cloud data architecture, strategy, and business intelligence.
  * **Strengths:** Slalom combines strategic management consulting with deep hands-on technical execution. Their Sydney team frequently designs Fabric Lakehouse patterns and optimizes Power BI Direct Lake performance to minimize reporting latency.
  * **Best For:** Enterprises wanting both data governance/operating model redesign alongside technical data platform engineering.

---

### Key Questions to Ask When Selecting Your Partner:

1. **Direct Lake vs. Import Mode:** Operational reporting often demands low latency. Ask candidates how they design around Microsoft Fabric's **Direct Lake mode** vs. traditional Import mode (and how they handle fallback thresholds and DAX performance).
2. **Fabric Capacity Sizing (F-SKUs):** Microsoft Fabric’s capacity model can cause throttling if operational pipelines and peak reporting periods compete for compute. Verify how the consultant plans to manage capacity smoothing and scaling.
3. **Medallion & Modeling Standards:** Ensure they specialize in dimensional modeling (Kimball) inside the Gold layer, as poor star-schema modeling will bottleneck Power BI performance regardless of how powerful the underlying warehouse is.

## Questions to ask before engaging one

text:
Several Microsoft partner consultancies and boutique AI automation agencies in Sydney specialise in **Microsoft Copilot Studio**, **AI agent architecture**, and **practical workflow automation** tailored for mid-market organisations. 

### 1. Premier Microsoft AI & Cloud Specialists
These consultancies bring deep technical capabilities across both low-code (Copilot Studio, Power Platform) and pro-code (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel) ecosystems.

* **Arinco** *(Sydney CBD - 24 Campbell St)*
  * **Core Focus:** Cloud, Data, and AI engineering. They offer dedicated offerings like the **Copilot Studio Agent Builder Accelerator** and hands-on **Agentathons**.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Ideal for businesses that want to move beyond generic chat to build autonomous, multi-step agents that interact with enterprise databases and line-of-business software via APIs. They bridge low-code Copilot Studio tools with robust Azure AI governance.
* **Engage Squared** *(Sydney & Melbourne)*
  * **Core Focus:** Recognized as a Microsoft Copilot Specialisation partner. They focus on Copilot Studio agent builds, workflow automation, and organizational adoption.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Strong choice if user adoption, governance, and change management are top priorities. Their **Secure Agentic Foundations** accelerator helps mid-market IT leaders manage data oversharing (via Microsoft Purview/Entra ID) before deploying custom agents.
* **Barhead Solutions** *(Sydney CBD - 123 Pitt St)*
  * **Core Focus:** Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Dynamics 365.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** If your mid-market automation relies heavily on CRM/ERP data (e.g., Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Dataverse), Barhead excels at embedding Copilot Studio agents directly into transactional workflows and automated approval loops.

---

### 2. Pragmatic, Mid-Market-First Consultancies
These firms operate without the overhead of enterprise tier-1 consultancies, delivering agile, fixed-scope, or outcome-focused automation.

* **Frontrow Technology** *(Sydney)*
  * **Core Focus:** Microsoft Copilot readiness, deployment, and custom Copilot Studio agent builds specifically for Sydney mid-market and lower enterprise clients.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Highly practical approach. They run fixed-scope assessments to remediate identity and SharePoint permission risks first, then build purpose-driven Copilot Studio agents grounded in company-specific operational data.
* **Eagle360 Consulting** *(Sydney)*
  * **Core Focus:** Microsoft Power Platform and Dynamics 365 Business Central automation.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Specifically tailored to Australian mid-market operational workflows. They specialize in building Copilot Studio agents that read/write into ERPs, process supplier invoices via AI Builder, and automate quote-to-cash sequences using Power Automate.
* **IOTAI** *(North Sydney - 99 Walker St)*
  * **Core Focus:** Custom Copilot Studio agents and workflow automation for SMBs and mid-market businesses.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Offers fast, fixed-fee deployment models (typically live in 2–4 weeks). They specialise in connecting Copilot agents not just to Microsoft 365, but also common Australian accounting and operations platforms like Xero and MYOB via custom connectors.
* **Synenza** *(Sydney)*
  * **Core Focus:** Copilot Studio agents, Power Platform integration, and Azure AI Foundry solutions.
  * **Mid-Market Fit:** Focused on turning repetitive manual tasks (IT triage, HR policy discovery, invoice reconciliation) into automated agent flows using Power Automate and Dataverse.

---

### Key Questions to Ask When Selecting a Consultant

1. **How do they handle data security and "oversharing"?**
   * *Why it matters:* Copilot and Copilot Studio respect existing SharePoint/OneDrive permissions. If your internal access controls are loose, deploying an agent can accidentally expose confidential executive or payroll data to general staff. A good partner will audit permissions and configure Microsoft Purview before deployment.
2. **Low-Code vs. Pro-Code Integration:**
   * If your workflows only involve SharePoint, Teams, and standard Microsoft 365 apps, standard **Copilot Studio + Power Automate** is sufficient.
   * If you need the agent to query legacy SQL databases, proprietary APIs, or perform complex logic, ensure the consultant has engineering skills in **Azure AI Foundry, REST APIs, and Semantic Kernel**.
3. **Licensing and Capacity Planning:**
   * Microsoft Copilot Studio requires message/capacity credits, which are separate from standard Microsoft 365 Copilot user seats. A good consultant will help you model query volumes and licensing costs before building.

text:
A strong Melbourne shortlist is **SSW, Engage Squared, jeylabs, Eagle360 Consulting, and Power Platform Experts**. The best choice depends on whether you need enterprise transformation, Microsoft 365 integration, Dynamics 365, or a smaller hands-on delivery team.

- **SSW — best for complex enterprise projects.** SSW has delivered Microsoft solutions for more than 1,000 clients across 15 countries and reports a large certified consulting team, Microsoft MVPs, and a Microsoft Regional Director. Its breadth makes it a strong option for architecture, governance, custom development, and large-scale Power Platform programs.[3]

- **Engage Squared — best for a substantial Melbourne-based Microsoft consultancy.** It appears among the larger Melbourne firms identified in a current directory of Power Platform consultants, with a reported local team size of 51–200 employees. Shortlist it for projects needing broader Microsoft 365, collaboration, and business-app capability alongside Power Platform delivery.[5]

- **jeylabs — best for personalised Power Apps and automation work.** Melbourne-based jeylabs offers Power Platform and Microsoft 365 consulting, workflow automation, application design, integration, development, and ongoing support, with both on-site and remote delivery.[1]

- **Eagle360 Consulting — best for Dynamics 365 Business Central and Copilot.** Eagle360 describes itself as a Microsoft Solutions Partner serving Sydney and Melbourne, with a focus on production Power Platform applications and Copilot agents connected to Business Central. It also emphasises architecture, governance, application lifecycle management, and testing—useful when reliability matters more than a quick prototype.[4]

- **Power Platform Experts — best for focused, end-to-end delivery and training.** The firm specialises in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Pages, covering design, development, deployment, training, and support. Its consultants are described as certified and experienced across the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.[9][10]

## How to choose

- Choose **SSW** for a large, technically demanding or regulated implementation.
- Choose **Engage Squared** when you want a sizeable Melbourne partner with wider Microsoft capability.
- Choose **jeylabs** for a more tailored app, workflow, or Microsoft 365 automation engagement.
- Choose **Eagle360** if Business Central, Copilot agents, or production-grade engineering is central.
- Choose **Power Platform Experts** for a focused implementation with user training and ongoing enablement.

Before appointing one, ask for two comparable Melbourne client references, named consultants and certifications, a proposed governance and environment strategy, details of licensing assumptions, and a fixed deliverable for an initial discovery or pilot. Directory rankings should be treated as lead-generation evidence rather than proof of quality; for example, the underlying Melbourne directory says its matching category does not represent a company-by-company quality assessment.[5]

- **SSW — best for complex enterprise projects.** SSW has delivered Microsoft solutions for more than 1,000 clients across 15 countries and reports a large certified consulting team, Microsoft MVPs, and a Microsoft Regional Director. Its breadth makes it a strong option for architecture, governance, custom development, and large-scale Power Platform programs.[3]

- **Engage Squared — best for a substantial Melbourne-based Microsoft consultancy.** It appears among the larger Melbourne firms identified in a current directory of Power Platform consultants, with a reported local team size of 51–200 employees. Shortlist it for projects needing broader Microsoft 365, collaboration, and business-app capability alongside Power Platform delivery.[5]

- **jeylabs — best for personalised Power Apps and automation work.** Melbourne-based jeylabs offers Power Platform and Microsoft 365 consulting, workflow automation, application design, integration, development, and ongoing support, with both on-site and remote delivery.[1]

- **Eagle360 Consulting — best for Dynamics 365 Business Central and Copilot.** Eagle360 describes itself as a Microsoft Solutions Partner serving Sydney and Melbourne, with a focus on production Power Platform applications and Copilot agents connected to Business Central. text:
When selecting a Microsoft Power Platform partner in Melbourne, the right choice depends on whether you need a **workplace enablement and governance partner**, a **deep Dynamics 365/enterprise integration**, or a **large-scale enterprise transformation**.

The following shortlist highlights reputable Microsoft consulting partners with established delivery teams and strong presences in Melbourne.

---

### 1. Engage Squared
* **Best for:** Workplace Automation, Adoption & Power Platform Governance (CoE)
* **Location:** Headquartered in Melbourne
* **Overview:** A multi-award-winning Microsoft partner (past Microsoft Australia Partner of the Year), Engage Squared specializes heavily in Microsoft 365, Copilot, and the Power Platform ecosystem. 
* **Why them:** 
  * They are widely regarded for combining technical development with **change management and human-centred design**.
  * Ideal for establishing a **Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE)**, setting up citizen-developer guardrails, preventing "sprawl," and digitising operational workflows (e.g., field-worker forms, internal request portals).

---

### 2. Barhead Solutions
* **Best for:** Complex Line-of-Business Apps, Dataverse & Dynamics 365 Alignment
* **Location:** Melbourne office (Docklands/CBD) & Sydney
* **Overview:** Barhead is a recognized tier-1 specialist in Microsoft Business Applications and Power Platform across Australia.
* **Why them:**
  * If your Power Platform initiative involves connecting directly to or building around **Dynamics 365 (CRM/ERP), Common Data Service / Dataverse**, or advanced custom connectors, Barhead is a top-tier choice.
  * They run regular Microsoft *“App in a Day”* training workshops and have extensive experience delivering regulated, secure apps for banking, non-profit, and public-sector clients.

---

### 3. Rapid Circle
* **Best for:** End-to-End Modern Workplace Modernisation & Legacy App Replacement
* **Location:** Melbourne office (along with Brisbane and Sydney)
* **Overview:** A Microsoft Cloud Solutions Partner with deep roots in modern workplace solutions, Rapid Circle expanded its Australian capability significantly in recent years.
* **Why them:**
  * Excellent for replacing antiquated setups (legacy SharePoint InfoPath forms, Lotus Notes, unwieldy Excel workflows) with modern Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio agents.
  * Strong technical discipline around secure architecture, Microsoft Teams integration, and identity management.

---

### 4. Professional Advantage
* **Best for:** Mid-Market Operations, ERP Integration & Power BI Reporting
* **Location:** Melbourne office (along with Sydney and Brisbane)
* **Overview:** In operation for over three decades, Professional Advantage is one of the most established Microsoft mid-market solutions providers in Australia.
* **Why them:**
  * Strong for businesses looking to tie Power Apps and Power Automate directly into core back-office systems like **Dynamics 365 Business Central**.
  * Proven delivery record in turning disparate business data into unified dashboards using **Power BI** alongside automated transactional workflows.

---

### 5. Avanade Australia
* **Best for:** Tier-1 Enterprise, Mission-Critical Scale & Regulated Sectors
* **Location:** Melbourne CBD
* **Overview:** The joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade is the heavyweight global systems integrator for Microsoft technologies.
* **Why them:**
  * If you operate in government, tier-1 banking, healthcare, or major infrastructure, and require multi-environment governance, dedicated enterprise ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) pipelines, and strict SOC/ISO compliance, Avanade has scale that boutique firms cannot match.
  * Ideal for large programmes where Power Platform forms only one part of an extensive Azure and AI transformation.

---

### Key Questions to Ask When Selecting a Consultant

Before engaging any partner, ensure you evaluate:
1. **Governance & ALM (DevOps):** Do they build apps in default environments, or do they establish formal Dev/Test/Prod pipelines and data loss prevention (DLP) policies?
2. **Licensing Advisory:** Power Platform licensing (per-app vs per-user vs Dataverse capacity vs PAYG Azure meters) can scale unpredictably. A good partner will help architect solutions to avoid unnecessary licensing costs.
3. **Copilot / AI Integration:** Ask how they leverage **Copilot Studio** and AI Builder natively within Power Automate/Power Apps.

text:
For Melbourne organisations specifically seeking **Microsoft Power Automate and business workflow automation**, these consultancies are the strongest shortlist:

- **OfficePro Consulting** — Best overall for Microsoft 365-centric businesses. It delivers Power Automate flows for approvals, reminders and handovers, plus Power Apps, Dataverse, Power BI and SharePoint. It offers onsite and remote delivery across Greater Melbourne.[5][7]
- **Communicat IT** — Strong choice when you want an independent recommendation between Power Automate and n8n. Its Melbourne team builds custom workflows, focuses on data sovereignty and supports Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint and desktop RPA scenarios.[9]
- **Solution Park** — Suitable for projects combining Power Automate with Dynamics 365, Power Apps, custom software or Power BI. It is Melbourne-based and provides discovery, deployment and ongoing support.[8]
- **jeylabs** — Best suited to larger or more advanced Microsoft engagements involving AI-powered workflow automation, Copilot, intelligent document processing, SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform.[6]
- **Alphavima Technologies** — A specialist Power Platform option offering process mapping, Power Automate, Power Apps, testing, documentation, training and post-launch support. Verify local delivery arrangements and Australian references before appointing them.[1][2][3]
- **CX IT Services** — Worth considering for SMBs wanting structured automation discovery and ROI prioritisation. It uses Power Automate for more complex or Microsoft 365-based workflows, alongside Make, Zapier and custom APIs.[10]

## Recommended choice by situation

| Requirement | Best starting point |
|---|---|
| Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Teams automation | OfficePro Consulting |
| Power Automate versus n8n evaluation | Communicat IT |
| Dynamics 365 plus Power Platform | Solution Park |
| AI, Copilot or intelligent document workflows | jeylabs |
| Formal process mapping and Power Platform governance | Alphavima |
| SMB automation discovery and ROI prioritisation | CX IT Services |

Before choosing, ask each firm for:

- Two recent Australian Power Automate case studies
- Experience with your systems, such as Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Xero, Salesforce or legacy databases
- Their approach to environments, solution packaging, security, licensing and governance
- A fixed-price discovery phase and a separate implementation estimate
- Post-launch monitoring, support and ownership of the flows
- Evidence that they can build maintainable solutions rather than isolated “quick fixes”

For most Melbourne businesses already using Microsoft 365, **OfficePro Consulting and Communicat IT** are the most practical first calls; **Solution Park** is a better fit when Dynamics 365 or bespoke development is central to the project.

text:
When selecting a consultancy in Melbourne for **business workflow automation** and **Microsoft Power Automate** implementation, the right choice depends heavily on your organization's size, technical complexity, and whether you need standalone workflow optimization or broader enterprise integration (such as Dynamics 365, SharePoint, or Azure AI).

---

### 1. Dedicated Microsoft Specialists & Pure-Plays (Best for Agility & Deep Platform Expertise)

*   **Engage Squared** *(Headquartered in Melbourne)*
    *   **Best for:** Modern workplace automation, SharePoint/Teams integration, and employee experience workflows.
    *   **Overview:** A top-tier Microsoft Solutions Partner and former Microsoft Partner of the Year. They excel at transforming manual, paper-heavy, or fragmented departmental processes (such as HR onboarding, approvals, quality management, and policy compliance) into structured Power Automate and Power Apps workflows. They also have strong change-management and Center of Excellence (CoE) governance practices.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Mid-market to enterprise businesses looking to modernize internal operations tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.

*   **Barhead Solutions** *(Melbourne office: Southbank)*
    *   **Best for:** End-to-end Power Platform, Dynamics 365 integration, and complex CRM/ERP automation.
    *   **Overview:** Recognized consistently as one of Microsoft’s leading Business Applications and Power Platform partners in Australia. Barhead focuses heavily on Power Apps, Power Automate (including Desktop RPA), and Copilot Studio. They are ideal if your workflow automation connects into customer service, finance, operations, or legacy desktop systems.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Organisations requiring formal process redesign, high-volume automated data pipelines, or integration with Dataverse and Dynamics.

*   **Arinco** *(Headquartered in Melbourne)*
    *   **Best for:** Technical architecture, Azure cloud automation, and AI-augmented workflows.
    *   **Overview:** Arinco focuses on deep Microsoft cloud engineering, bridging the gap between low-code Power Automate and high-code Azure infrastructure (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, AI Builder, and Copilot Studio). If your automation requires custom API connectors, complex logic, enterprise security guardrails, or generative AI agent integration, Arinco is a front-runner.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Organizations with complex IT environments wanting enterprise-grade architecture, application lifecycle management (ALM), and AI-driven automation.

*   **FiveP** *(Melbourne-based)*
    *   **Best for:** Process digitisation, Microsoft 365 governance, and flexible ongoing support.
    *   **Overview:** FiveP is a boutique Melbourne consultancy specializing in Microsoft digital workplace solutions. They run structured Power Platform "Foundations" and CoE deployment services to help teams eliminate spreadsheet-based processes safely without creating shadow IT.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Mid-sized businesses and regulated non-profits looking for a collaborative, high-touch local partner.

---

### 2. Mid-Market ERP, CRM & Business Process Specialists

*   **Professional Advantage** *(Melbourne office: St Kilda Rd)*
    *   **Best for:** Finance and operational workflow automation (e.g., invoice approvals, purchase orders, ERP routing).
    *   **Overview:** One of Australia’s longest-standing mid-market IT consultancies. They have a dedicated Microsoft Business Applications practice connecting Power Automate with Business Central, Dynamics 365, and third-party accounting/finance platforms.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Companies whose automation needs center around core financial operations, supply chain, and reporting.

*   **Rapid Circle** *(Melbourne presence)*
    *   **Best for:** Cloud-first process automation, Microsoft Teams app integration, and citizen developer enablement.
    *   **Overview:** Following acquisitions of Australian firms like Insync Technology, Rapid Circle has built a strong national practice around helping organisations move from legacy SharePoint/InfoPath workflows to modern Power Automate cloud flows and governance frameworks.

---

### 3. Global Systems Integrators (Best for Enterprise & Multinationals)

*   **Avanade Australia** *(Melbourne office: Bourke St)*
    *   **Best for:** Massive enterprise transformations, high-security government/banking environments, and full-scale Robotic Process Automation (RPA).
    *   **Overview:** A joint venture between Accenture and Microsoft, Avanade possesses the largest pool of certified Microsoft professionals in the region. If you need complex multi-region rollouts, unattended desktop RPA replacing legacy software, or multi-system SAP/Salesforce/Microsoft automation, they are the standard enterprise choice.
    *   **Ideal Fit:** Large enterprises and government agencies with massive compliance and scalability needs.

---

### How to Choose Among Them

| Need / Priority | Recommended Partner |
| :--- | :--- |
| **SharePoint / M365 collaboration & workplace productivity** | **Engage Squared** or **FiveP** |
| **Dynamics 365 / CRM / Field Service / Enterprise RPA** | **Barhead Solutions** |
| **Azure integration, custom connectors, AI / Copilot Studio** | **Arinco** |
| **Finance / ERP-centric workflow (Business Central / Nav)** | **Professional Advantage** |
| **Global scale, heavy compliance, Tier-1 enterprise** | **Avanade** |

### Questions to Ask Potential Partners
1. **Governance & ALM:** *"Do you implement the Microsoft Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit and Environment Lifecycle Management so we don't end up with unmaintained rogue flows?"*
2. **Architecture:** *"When do you recommend using Power Automate Cloud Flows vs. Desktop Flows (RPA) vs. Azure Logic Apps for our specific volume?"*
3. **Licensing Advisory:** Power Automate licensing (per-user vs. per-flow vs. hosted RPA) can become expensive quickly; ensure the consultancy provides licensing optimization as part of their scoping.

For a Melbourne manufacturer that wants to automate order processing, capture shop-floor data and streamline operations **without replacing its existing ERP**, I’d shortlist specialist Microsoft Power Platform consultancies first, then compare them with a manufacturing-focused industrial automation provider.

The key is finding a partner that can connect Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI to your existing ERP, rather than proposing another major system replacement. Microsoft’s own reference architecture demonstrates how Power Platform can support operational workflows while leaving the ERP as the system of record. (Best overall fit)

Website: [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/)

Inturing explicitly targets manufacturers running existing ERP, MES and PLM systems. Its services cover order processing, document extraction, system integration, shop-floor apps and operational reporting. Its published BBCP case study describes automation across MYOB Acumatica, SAP Ariba and SharePoint, with a reported reduction of over 90% in order-processing time. [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/manufacturing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Ask them about\:** automating emailed purchase orders, validating orders against ERP master data, and capturing production progress and quality checks on tablets.

---

![Требуется авторизация - 429](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qQV0MTV3yVOO0MUqsCJHz13LR29FVhW7qnrqhE3KE-f1qvBRD3VyF06BFcL4QtUXJzoViVCwzwC88b4xGr5a0M3mwKEcVgryamkypJnkYMi-I6J8CjV8vGJqY_TPWhKmkqC6V3v8kIN8HBcifG2ue_90qpn9ZGoQHDvRkQnLh0Q5cbP9bz-MfP7LVxOvcOjP?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. SP Software & Automation

Worth speaking to if your shop-floor requirements extend beyond forms and approvals into production data, machine monitoring, quality records or industrial systems. **Ask them about\:** integrating machine or production data with your ERP and Power BI, and where industrial controls or a dedicated manufacturing data platform are needed alongside Power Platform.

**Ask them about\:** building shop-floor capture apps and automated order workflows that integrate with your particular ERP without introducing a competing system of record.

**Ask them about\:** a broader automation roadmap if several departments, multiple sites or complicated ERP integrations need to be coordinated.

## How I’d prioritise the shortlist

| Your main requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Automate order entry and reduce manual admin | **Inturing** |
| Connect production-floor or machine data | **SP Software & Automation** |
| Build Power Apps and connect Microsoft systems | **1Dynamics** |
| Extend existing Microsoft business applications | **MiiiA** |
| Build supportable apps with strong governance | **Hyperware** |
| Coordinate a larger, more complex automation programme | **Velrada** |


These are recommendations based on publicly described capabilities, not a guarantee that every firm has delivered your exact ERP integration. I would validate relevant references before selecting a partner.



## What to ask each consultant

I would give all shortlisted firms the same brief and ask for a small, fixed-scope discovery engagement covering these five points.

- **ERP integration\:** Can you read and write data through our ERP's supported APIs, connectors or integration layer, without replacing it?
- **Order processing\:** Can you extract order details from emails and PDFs, validate customer, product, price and quantity, and send exceptions to a person for review?
- **Shop-floor capture\:** Can operators record job status, quantities, downtime and quality checks on shared tablets, including offline use where required?
- **Data ownership\:** How will you prevent duplicate records and ensure the ERP remains the authoritative source for orders, inventory and financial transactions?
- **Reliability and cost\:** What happens when an integration fails, and what are the expected implementation, licensing, support and ongoing maintenance costs?

For shop-floor work, specifically ask whether Power Apps is sufficient or whether you need an MES, PLC/SCADA integration or another industrial data platform. These are different technical problems, even if they ultimately feed the same dashboards.

Ask each to propose one pilot, with measurable targets and no ERP replacement. For example, automate one product line's incoming orders or digitise one production cell's job and quality records before expanding.

- **Add Office Experts** for an additional Power Platform implementation comparison.

- Order intake from email, EDI, portals or customer documents into the existing ERP.

text:
Extending an existing ERP rather than replacing it—often called a **“surround and extend”** or **“ERP wrap-around”** architecture—is one of the most cost-effective ways for mid-market manufacturers to modernize. 

For your specific needs:
* **Order Processing:** Inbound PO extraction via Power Automate + AI Builder (Document Intelligence) with human-in-the-loop validation, pushing orders directly into the ERP via API or staging tables.
* **Shop-Floor Data Capture:** Rugged tablet/mobile Canvas Apps with barcode/QR scanning for work order tracking, machine downtime, inventory movements, and scrap recording.

The following Microsoft automation and Power Platform consultancies with strong Melbourne footprints specialize in this type of work:

---

### 1. Mid-Market Specialists (Best for Practical, Rapid Delivery)

* **Barhead Solutions (Melbourne Office)**
  * **Why them:** One of Australia’s most awarded Microsoft Business Applications partners. They specialize in Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, AI Builder) and have dedicated consulting pods that build operational apps on top of legacy or non-Microsoft ERPs.
  * **Best fit:** If you want standard-aligned, enterprise-grade governance combined with rapid prototyping for shop-floor workflows.
* **Professional Advantage (Melbourne Office)**
  * **Why them:** A long-established Australian systems integrator with deep roots in manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution. Unlike pure software-house consultancies, they understand supply chain realities, inventory valuation, and legacy accounting/ERP backends.
  * **Best fit:** If your existing ERP is traditional mid-market software (e.g., Pronto, older Dynamics, Infor, Sybiz) and you need people who understand accounting integrity alongside low-code.
* **Exco Partners (Melbourne-based)**
  * **Why them:** A Melbourne-headquartered digital consultancy and Microsoft partner focused on systems integration, operational automation, and Power Apps. They specialize in linking cloud-native apps into older enterprise data environments.
  * **Best fit:** If you want a local, agile Melbourne team that focuses heavily on user experience and business process re-engineering.

---

### 2. Deep Integration & Cloud Specialists (Best for On-Prem / Hybrid ERPs)

* **Arinco (Melbourne Presence)**
  * **Why them:** A fast-growing Australian cloud consultancy specializing in the intersection of Microsoft Azure and Power Platform. 
  * **Best fit:** If your ERP doesn't have modern REST APIs and requires **Azure Integration Services** (e.g., Azure Logic Apps, On-Premises Data Gateway, direct SQL/ODBC connectors) to safely bridge shop-floor Power Apps to your ERP database without causing performance bottlenecks.
* **Antares Solutions**
  * **Why them:** Strong expertise in enterprise automation, AI document processing (converting complex customer purchase order PDFs into structured data), and Power Platform governance.
  * **Best fit:** If automated PDF/email order ingestion and complex multi-step approval workflows are the primary pain points.

---

### 3. ERP-Native Integrators (If you use a common Tier-2 ERP)

* **MicroChannel (Melbourne Office)**
  * **Why them:** They are one of the largest ERP implementers in ANZ (SAP Business One, Sage, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.). Because they implement ERPs, they understand the schema and database locks that occur when external apps push data in.
  * **Best fit:** If you want a partner who knows how to build Power Apps without corrupting or breaking standard ERP business logic.

---

### Key Questions to Ask When Vetting Them

Before engaging a partner, test them on these manufacturing-specific considerations:

1. **ERP Concurrency & Staging Tables:**  
   * *Ask:* "Will the shop-floor app write directly to the ERP via API, or will it write to Dataverse/Azure SQL staging tables that batch-sync?" *(Writing directly from 20 tablets on a shop floor can lock ERP transaction tables; a staging architecture is generally safer).*
2. **Shop-Floor Hardware & Environment:**  
   * *Ask:* "Have you built Canvas apps for industrial environments (touch-target sizing for gloved hands, integration with Zebra/Honeywell barcode scanners, and handling offline caching if the factory floor has Wi-Fi dead zones)?"
3. **Microsoft Licensing Architecture:**  
   * *Ask:* "How will you design this so we don't breach Microsoft multiplexing rules, while keeping per-user Power Apps licensing costs manageable across our operational workforce?"
4. **Order Processing Exception Handling:**  
   * *Ask:* "How does your proposed AI Builder solution handle mismatched line item SKUs, varying unit-of-measure conversions (e.g., packs vs. eaches), or low-quality scanned PDFs?" *(A mature partner will already have a pre-built human-in-the-loop review screen).*

snippet: When building custom operational applications on **Microsoft Power Apps and Dataverse** for warehouse floors, manufacturing lines, and field operations, standard "citizen developer" consultants usually fall short.
